patient_id.verdict: random UUID4 per row -- generated, not a registry identifier

ethnicity.expected_from_literature: ~2x higher rate in Black and Hispanic patients (CDC, MLOF, UKHCDO)
ethnicity.verdict: flat across all groups -- the best-replicated non-genetic effect in inhibitor epidemiology is absent, which a real cohort of this size would not show

family_history.verdict: matches the published figure to two decimals

age_vs_exposure.verdict: near-deterministic for a clinical pair -- consistent with one being generated from the other

provenance.conclusion: The clinical block is simulated. CHAMP rows are published variants, not patients, so there is no key on which real clinical data could have been joined; the four signatures above confirm generation with hand-chosen effect sizes. Performance obtained from these columns is circular and cannot be reported as validation. It is reported here as a power analysis instead.
